 MI 2027 Retentions: Released, Retained & Trade Players List Ahead of IPL 2027 Auction
 Mumbai Indians (MI) have released five players ahead of next month's IPL 2027 mini-auction.
 By Adreej Kumar Mitra Published - 17 Nov 2026, 15:42 IST 
 12 Min Read
 Deepak Chahar. (Photo by Pankaj Nangia/Getty Images) Mumbai Indians (MI) have released five players ahead of next month's IPL 2027 mini-auction. Earlier this month, they traded in Arshdeep Singh from the Punjab Kings and gave Hardik Pandya to the Shreyas Iyer-led side.
 The five-time champions will look to bounce back strongly after a disappointing campaign in IPL 2026. They will have a new skipper at the helm, with Rohit Sharma, Suryakumar Yadav, and Tilak Varma being the three primary contenders.
 Mumbai Indians retained most of their core players and let go of only five members. The biggest name from the releases has to be that of Deepak Chahar. The seam-bowling all-rounder has struggled with injuries and played in only eight matches last season.
 All eyes will now be on the IPL 2027 mini-auction, which will be held in Goa on December 16. MI will not have to make too many purchases as they haven't released too many big names ahead of the event. However, letting go of Chahar will add INR 9.25 crore to their purse.
